shots.p: wide shot of a quiet desert at dawn, three distant rock pillars glowing softly, contemplative stillness
wide shot of the vast universe of stars and galaxies above the earth, certain truth and majesty
medium shot of scornful men accusing in a market, while a sunrise breaks over people who had no warner before
wide shot of the heavens and earth in six bands of light from dawn to dusk, majestic creation
wide shot of rain descending from sky to earth and mist rising back, the long ages of time in the clouds
close-up of a closed seashell on the deep sea floor, hidden things known, merciful calm
close-up of hands of clay and soil shaped carefully, the beginning of human creation, no figure
close-up of a single drop of water on a leaf, humble origin of life
close-up of a newborn baby opening its eyes in the morning, hearing and seeing for the first time
medium shot of skeptical men in a graveyard holding dust, doubting resurrection
wide shot of an autumn tree dropping its last leaf, every soul taken at its appointed time
close-up of guilty men with heads bowed in shame, begging to be sent back
wide shot of a crowd split into a lit path and a dark one, choices made
close-up of a heedless man surrounded by smoke, the consequence of forgetting
medium shot of believers falling into prostration with tears when a recitation is heard
medium shot of a man leaving his bed at night to pray, hands raised in fear and hope, moonlight
wide shot of a hidden treasure chest glowing softly in a quiet garden, unseen delight
split shot: a believer kneeling in prayer at dawn and a defiant man turning away at dusk
wide shot of beautiful garden dwellings with flowing streams, a welcoming home of rest
wide shot of a raging fire behind iron gates on a dark horizon, symbolic and non-graphic
medium shot of people suffering drought and disease in a village, a wake-up call to return
close-up of a man turning his back on a book of reminders, arrogant
close-up of ancient stone tablets on a mountain at dawn, guidance given
medium shot of patient scholars teaching people in a hall, certain faith
close-up of balanced scales in a quiet hall, judgment between those who differed
wide shot of travellers walking among the ruins of destroyed ancient towns
wide shot of rivers flowing into dry barren land and crops sprouting, cattle grazing
medium shot of mocking men asking when the decisive day comes, smirking
close-up of regretful faces of mockers realizing too late
medium shot of a man turning away calmly from the mockers to wait patiently at sunset
